summaryZh: Jennings 实验室研究蛋白质折叠与组装如何影响信号传导，探索折叠、误折叠和功能的能量景观。以IL-1β、蛋白激酶、GFP及mitoNEET家族等体系，结合实验与理论研究分子识别、变构调节和活性。
researchQuestions: 蛋白质折叠与组装如何影响信号传导及分子功能？
如何统一描述蛋白质折叠与功能的能量景观，并解释识别、变构调节和底物结合？
topics: 蛋白质折叠、误折叠与能量景观
信号蛋白的结构与功能

evidence.quote: Our particular research interests are focused on investigating how protein folding and assembly impacts important signaling processes and on understanding the basic biophysical rules that govern those processes.
in vitro, in vivo and in silico
Molecular biophysics techniques allow the quantitative examination of atomic and molecular motions
energy landscape that controls the folding/misfolding of proteins.
cytokine Interleukin-1b (IL-1b) on diverse structural systems such as protein kinases, green fluorescent protein and the mitoNEET family of proteins.
recognition, allosteric modulation, substrate binding and activity
The real challenge we are undertaking is to generalize these ideas to accommodate both folding and function.
